title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 12 March 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 11 March 2026 Several spells of showers will occur in Uva province and in Batticaloa, Ampara, and Hambantota districts. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts after 2.00 pm. Mainly fair weather will prevail elsewhere over the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
